aiMetadata.description: Sends an email to one or more recipients via the Mailjet transactional send API. Supply the body inline as plain text and/or HTML, or set a Mailjet template ID to render a predefined template with optional variables. Use when delivering a notification, alert, or transactional message; the sender address must be a verified Mailjet sender. Not idempotent — each call dispatches a new email.
